g.text: Judges and fans can favor different weekly exits
Judge weight 0.5 shown · each point is one model's conditional posterior mean; faint bars are marginal 95% credible intervals
Higher percentiles remove a weaker-ranked contestant. All 18 policies and six objectives enter the separate Pareto tables.
